verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents real-time transaction-level tax calculation with address validation/jurisdiction mapping (not ZIP-only), REST API with SDKs in multiple languages, a CreateTransaction endpoint for checkout-time calls, and global coverage across 200+ countries; a free trial and API explorer support developer integration. Missing for 10: no explicit latency/performance benchmarks for checkout-speed claims and no independent/hands-on corroboration of address-level rooftop accuracy versus ZIP approximation.
